user.title: Fortunes
user.description: Choose the language of the fortune cookies. If the folder for this language (for example {path}/de) contains no fortune files, they are downloaded once from the Debian archive. The collections have their own licenses, see the README.

error.download_failed: Download from the Debian archive failed. Check your internet connection or add the files manually (see README, details in the log).
error.no_fortunes: No usable fortune files found for this language. Please see the README.
